# Briller

> Briller is an AI co-pilot for interior design and architectural visualisation. The marketing website is https://briller.house. The app is https://build.briller.house.

## Product
- [Features](https://briller.house/en/features/): Photo and sketch-led concepts, moodboards, natural-language and voice interaction, Briller Insights, Shop the Look, optional drawings and Smart Sparks.
- [Solutions](https://briller.house/en/solutions/): Browse 27 audience and use-case pages by role or project. Includes homeowners, renters, remote workers, designers, architects, contractors, kitchen/bath remodelers, real estate agents, investors, developers and rental hosts.
- [Pricing](https://briller.house/en/pricing/): Free includes 3 active projects and 20 watermarked iterations per month. Explorer: $9.99/month, or $7.99 monthly equivalent billed annually, 60 credits/month. Pro Design: $24.99/month, or $19.99 monthly equivalent billed annually, 200 credits/month. Studio / Architect: $69.99/month, or $59.99 monthly equivalent billed annually, 650 credits/month and 3 team seats. Confirm taxes and entitlements in app checkout.
- [FAQ](https://briller.house/en/faq/): Workflow, credits, billing and limitations.
- [Contact](https://briller.house/en/contact/): hello@briller.house.
- [Українська версія](https://briller.house/uk/): Повна українська версія маркетингового сайту.

## Interpretation
AI outputs are visual concepts and should be checked against the original room. They are not verified construction documents. The inspiration gallery is curated illustrative photography, not verified Briller output, public customer projects or proof of generation quality. Legal pages are drafts awaiting company information and legal-policy confirmation. Billing and accounts are handled by the app; this website does not authenticate users or process payments.

## Knowledge behind Briller.House
Briller.House's AI-assisted knowledge base brings together Mike Briller's hands-on experience and the practical know-how of his colleagues: architects, designers and construction workers. It covers modern design and construction solutions, budget options and implementation details. Mike Briller is a real person and the face of the project, representing this shared expertise. His YouTube channel is https://www.youtube.com/@BrillerBuilds.

## Solutions directory
- [First room refresh](https://briller.house/en/solutions/first-room-refresh/): Upload one room, describe the direction, and see it before you spend a dollar on it.
- [Whole-home renovation](https://briller.house/en/solutions/whole-home-renovation-planning/): One project per room, each with its own history — so three renovations don't turn into one blur.
- [Renter-friendly makeover](https://briller.house/en/solutions/renter-friendly-makeover/): Upload the room, describe the direction, explore reversible changes to discuss with your landlord.
- [Home office & workspace](https://briller.house/en/solutions/home-office-workspace/): One small room or corner, one small budget, a real difference in how it functions.
- [Interior designers & decorators](https://briller.house/en/solutions/interior-designers-freelance-decorators/): Upload the client's room and moodboard, describe the direction, iterate in minutes instead of days.
- [Architects & architecture studios](https://briller.house/en/solutions/architects-architecture-studios/): Upload blueprints alongside the room photo — dimensions and constraints inform the render, not just the finish.
- [Contractors & remodeling companies](https://briller.house/en/solutions/general-contractors-remodeling-companies/): Show them a direction, hand them a materials list they can actually price against.
- [Kitchen & bath remodelers](https://briller.house/en/solutions/kitchen-bath-remodelers/): Briller's notes go into cabinetry, plumbing, and ventilation — not just the paint color.
- [Real estate agents & listing prep](https://briller.house/en/solutions/real-estate-agents-listing-prep/): Upload a listing photo, stage the room, let the before/after do the work.
- [Property investors & house flippers](https://briller.house/en/solutions/real-estate-investors-house-flippers/): Photograph the rooms that need work, get a direction with real cost logic attached, before you're locked into a purchase.
- [Property developers](https://briller.house/en/solutions/property-developers/): Turn a blueprint into a buyer-facing render, with the material story to back it up in the sales deck.
- [Short-term rental & Airbnb hosts](https://briller.house/en/solutions/short-term-rental-airbnb-hosts/): Describe your furnishing budget, see a few directions, then shop the pieces that got you there.
- [Try a design style](https://briller.house/en/solutions/try-a-design-style/): Upload your room, run it through Japandi, Scandinavian, Industrial, Modern Minimalism, and Classic, and see what actually fits.
- [Paint & wall colours](https://briller.house/en/solutions/paint-wall-color-testing/): Upload the room, describe the color direction, see it on your actual walls before buying a sample.
- [Lighting & fixtures](https://briller.house/en/solutions/lighting-design-fixture-selection/): Upload the room as it is, tell Briller what's wrong with the light, and see fixture and placement changes before you buy anything.
- [Flooring & finishes](https://briller.house/en/solutions/flooring-finish-comparison/): One room, three flooring directions, each with its own Materials and Installation notes.
- [Kitchen surfaces](https://briller.house/en/solutions/kitchen-surfaces/): The three decisions that drive a kitchen budget, shown together in your actual room.
- [Fireplace & mantel](https://briller.house/en/solutions/fireplace-mantel-redesign/): Upload the room, describe the fireplace direction, see it restyled without redesigning the whole room around it.
- [Closets & built-in storage](https://briller.house/en/solutions/closet-built-in-storage-redesign/): Upload the closet or storage space, describe what actually needs to fit, see a layout before you build it.
- [Small spaces & studio apartments](https://briller.house/en/solutions/small-space-studio-apartment-layout/): Upload the room, describe what it needs to do, see a layout that actually works at the scale you have.
- [Nursery & kids’ rooms](https://briller.house/en/solutions/nursery-kids-room-design/): Upload the room, describe the direction, see it before the deadline gets closer.
- [Home gym](https://briller.house/en/solutions/home-gym-conversion/): Upload the room, describe the equipment and layout, see if it actually fits before you buy anything.
- [Open-plan layout concepts](https://briller.house/en/solutions/open-concept-wall-removal/): Visualize an opened-up sightline as a concept, before anyone determines whether the wall can actually come down.
- [Basement & garage conversions](https://briller.house/en/solutions/basement-garage-conversion/): Upload the unfinished space, describe what you want it to become, see it before committing to the build-out.
- [Exterior & curb appeal](https://briller.house/en/solutions/exterior-curb-appeal/): Upload the exterior, describe the direction, see siding, paint, and entryway changes before you buy any of it.
- [Backyard & outdoor living](https://briller.house/en/solutions/backyard-outdoor-living-redesign/): Upload the outdoor space, describe the direction, see a patio, deck, or seating area before you build any of it.
- [Rental turnover refresh](https://briller.house/en/solutions/airbnb-turnover-refresh/): Upload the room as it stands today, describe a fast style update, see it before the next booking window.

## Plan capabilities
Commercial licensing is available on all paid plans. PDF specification export and a dedicated faster generation queue are available on Pro Design and Studio / Architect. Shared projects are available on Studio / Architect, which includes three team seats. Confirm current terms and entitlements in the app.
